ops.body: Shipped in v0.49.0 (77f03928): reportOrphanFPDomains scans ~/Library/CloudStorage for CCPoolStatus-acct-NN folders with no accounts row; --fix deregisters only after the full predicate (row absent, account dir + private root absent, DomainRoot-confirmed) passes twice — at scan and again immediately before removal. Unreadable state / unreachable app / mid-confirm change = advisory only.
